**3 — Items:** Bun, breaded chicken, lettuce, pickle, tomato, creamy sauce and toast. No separate butter or oil is clearly visible; frying oil is included in the chicken’s energy density.

**4 — Area:** The sandwich covers approximately **20%** of the plate and the toast **22%**, totaling **42% food coverage**. Sandwich components overlap, so their layer areas below are not added to the plate coverage.
